# OpenZilo

> OpenZilo is a Python 3.10+ SDK and CLI for compatible BLE rings. This index points coding agents to the repository's maintained documentation. The SDK API is defined by `src/openzilo.py` and its `__all__` list.

Current SDK release: 0.5.0. Documented device protocol baseline: v4, firmware `V2.000.0001.0015`. Firmware and SDK versions evolve independently. Hardware dependent behavior must be checked on the target device.

The [OpenZilo website](https://openzilo.com) describes a broader platform. Do not infer Python PPG APIs or a TypeScript package from its product concepts; use this repository's public API guide and `src/openzilo.py.__all__` for implemented SDK features.

## Start here

- [README (English)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ziloai/openzilo/main/README.md): install, first commands, requirements, and project status.
- [README (简体中文)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ziloai/openzilo/main/README.zh-CN.md): Chinese quick start and navigation.
- [Python SDK guide (简体中文)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ziloai/openzilo/main/docs/python-sdk.zh-CN.md): public types, functions, parameters, return values, exceptions, and examples.
- [Protocol reference (简体中文)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ziloai/openzilo/main/docs/protocol.zh-CN.md): v4 packet format and command bodies used by the SDK.
- [Architecture and data flow (简体中文)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ziloai/openzilo/main/docs/architecture.zh-CN.md): BLE framing, recording transfer, audio decoding, and IMU events.
- [Coding agent setup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ziloai/openzilo/main/docs/ai-tools.md): how to use this SDK with Codex, Claude Code, and other coding tools.

## Agent integration notes

- Install from a Git clone with `python -m pip install -e .`; the package is not yet published to PyPI.
- Import with `import openzilo as sdk` or use `python -m openzilo --help`.
- `sdk.OpenZiloClient` is the connected BLE session; pass it to high-level functions such as `sdk.get_system_info(client)`.
- `ffmpeg` is only required when converting Speex recordings to WAV.
- `audio-clear` permanently erases device recordings and requires `--yes`.
- Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode use `AGENTS.md`. Claude Code uses `CLAUDE.md` and Gemini CLI uses `GEMINI.md`, both importing `AGENTS.md`. GitHub Copilot uses `.github/copilot-instructions.md` for repository guidance. This `llms.txt` remains a documentation index and is not automatically consumed as a plugin or MCP server.
